_how_to_add: Add only real reviews that a customer sent you (WhatsApp, Facebook, in person). Never write one yourself.
Copy _template below into the reviews list and fill it in. 'product' is the product slug from the page URL, e.g. bigman-forza-protein-2kg.
name: the customer's name as they agree to show it. city: their town (optional). rating: 1 to 5. text: their own words. date: the day they sent it, as YYYY-MM-DD.
en (optional): English translation if they wrote in Nepali. image (optional): photo in source/reviews/, written as 'reviews/<file>.jpg', only with their permission.
The stars, the product's average rating and Google review data appear automatically once a product has a review.
